subject.title: feat: unify external sessions with native catalog pagination

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `sessions.catalog.*` and `registerSessionCatalog` as the public generic contract for external session catalogs, with catalogs visible whenever the owning plugin is active?
rationale: This establishes a durable Plugin SDK and Gateway surface and changes the product boundary from provider-specific optional views to native catalog visibility; implementation review cannot decide that product commitment.

options.title: Adopt the generic contract
options.body: Approve the public API and native catalog direction after the lifecycle defect, conflicts, and proof gaps are resolved.

options.title: Narrow to internal browsing
options.body: Keep the catalog implementation internal or provider-specific until the external Plugin SDK contract is further designed.

options.title: Pause the unification
options.body: Retain the existing session surfaces and substantially re-scope or close this branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic contract
recommendation.body: Approve the public API and native catalog direction after the lifecycle defect, conflicts, and proof gaps are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history and linked design issue identify this person as the current design owner for both provider catalogs and the native session UX.
